question: In which of the following Indian states is Palkhi festival observed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

• **Palki Festival **showcases the distinctive point of the** Maharashtrian culture.**
 
• **This is a 1000- time-old tradition, which has been followed by the workers (people who follow the wari, an abecedarian ritual).**
